description: Header file defining structures, constants, classes, and helper functions for remote control key mappings, IR-RF database flags, and IARM communication in the RDK platform.

classes.name: KeyGroupSrcInfo
classes.description: Holds information about key group sources for decision making.

classes.name: RFKeyFlags
classes.description: Represents flags for RF keys, with methods to set, clear, and check keys.

classes.name: KeyPresenceFlags
classes.description: Contains RFKeyFlags for TV and AVR presence detection.

classes.name: IRRFDBCtrlrLoadProgress
classes.description: Tracks the load/read progress of IR-RF database slots for a controller.

classes.name: keyActionMap
classes.description: Represents a mapping of a key to IR data for TV and AVR.

classes.name: RemoteActionMappingHelper
classes.description: Helper class managing IARM communication for remote control key mappings and IR database operations.

methods.name: getLastUsedDeviceID
methods.description: Retrieves the last used device ID and related info.

methods.name: getControllerByID
methods.description: Gets controller info by device ID.

methods.name: setKeyActionMap
methods.description: Sets key action map for a device.

methods.name: getKeyActionMap
methods.description: Retrieves key action map for a device.

methods.name: clearKeyActionMap
methods.description: Clears key action map for a device.

methods.name: setFiveDigitCode
methods.description: Sets a five-digit code for TV or AVR.

methods.name: setIRDBDownloadFlag
methods.description: Sets the IR-RF database download flag for a device.

methods.name: setFiveDigitCodeFlags
methods.description: Sets flags related to five-digit codes.

methods.name: getControllerLoadStatus
methods.description: Gets load status of IR-RF database for a controller.

methods.name: lookupRFKey
methods.description: Looks up RF key code from key name.

methods.name: lookupKeyname
methods.description: Looks up key name from RF key code.

methods.name: setDevicePower
methods.description: Sets power state for a device.

methods.name: clearDevicePower
methods.description: Clears power state for a device.
